content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Kyro AI: Sales Development Representative Anywhere in the World Alabama Sales Management, Sales, Client Relationship Management, Communication Skills, Client Relations, Sales Enablement, and Stakeholder Communication Sales and Marketing Contract <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6563/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Texas <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://kyro.ai">https://kyro.ai</a> </p> <p>Sales Development Representative (SDR)</p> <p>Location: Remote, non-US based, working US Central Time business hours<br>Experience: 1-3 years in a B2B SDR/BDR role<br>Employment type: Full-time<br>Reports to: Product Manager - Growth</p> <p>ABOUT KYRO AI<br>When a major storm knocks out power, utilities race to mobilize crews and get the lights back on. Kyro AI builds the software behind that effort: workforce and contractor management for electric utilities, storm restoration contractors, and aggregators. We are headquartered in Plano, Texas, and were spun off from Think Power Solutions, so we pair long-standing utility expertise with the pace and ownership of a product company.<br><br><a href="https://kyro.ai/">https://kyro.ai/</a></p> <p>WHY JOIN KYRO<br>- Work that matters: our platform helps communities get power back after storms and keeps a critical, regulated industry compliant.<br>- A growing product suite: StormShield for storm restoration, Kyro Capital for contractor invoice factoring, KORY (our AI copilot), and contractor onboarding and verification.<br>- Credibility from day one: you sell with the backing of real utility relationships and domain know-how.<br>- Close to leadership: direct access to the CEO and product team, and what you hear from customers shapes the roadmap.<br>- Room to grow: a clear path from SDR to Account Executive.<br>- Flexibility: fully remote team.</p> <p>THE ROLE<br>As an SDR, you are the first conversation most utilities and contractors have with Kyro. You will work two segments with very different buying motions:</p> <p>Utilities (enterprise): You will talk to storm response, emergency management, contractor management, supply chain, and procurement leaders. Cycles are long, involve multiple stakeholders, and are often tied to RFIs/RFPs. A win is a qualified discovery meeting or demo handed to the account team.</p> <p>Contractors (SMB to mid-market): You will talk to owners, operations managers, and storm coordinators at line, vegetation, and restoration contractors. Cycles are shorter, phone-first, and owner-led. A win is a demo held and the contractor signed up and onboarded.</p> <p>WHAT YOU'LL DO<br>- Prospect outbound: research target utilities and contractors, build account lists, and reach decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn.<br>- Own the follow-up: run multi-touch cadences, chase no-shows and stalled conversations, and make sure every lead has a dated next step.<br>- Respond to inbound leads the same business day and qualify them before they go cold.<br>- Qualify with rigor: confirm need, timeline, decision process, budget, and compliance requirements before booking.<br>- Book and confirm demos, send reminders, and hand off with clear notes.<br>- Drive conversions: stay with contractors after the demo until they sign up and start onboarding; keep utility opportunities moving to the next stage.<br>- Keep the CRM clean: log every activity, stage change, and next step.<br>- Feed the product team: share objections, competitor mentions, and feature requests from the field.</p> <p>HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED<br>Success is measured on demos held and the conversions that follow. Activity counts are leading indicators, not the goal. KPIs: demos booked, demos held, demo-to-opportunity rate, conversions (contractors signed up and onboarded; utility opportunities advanced to proposal or pilot), pipeline sourced, speed to lead, follow-up coverage (share of open leads with a dated next step), and outreach activity. Targets are set separately for each segment; utility credit weighs meetings and pipeline more than closed conversions.</p> <p>WHAT YOU BRING<br>- 1-3 years as an SDR or BDR in B2B sales, ideally SaaS, with a record of hitting or beating meeting and demo quotas<br>- Disciplined follow-up across phone, email, and LinkedIn without being reminded<br>- Confident cold calling, including with field-oriented buyers who rarely live in their inbox<br>- Clear, concise written communication<br>- Hands-on experience with a CRM and a sales engagement tool (HubSpot, Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar)<br>- Comfort with metrics: you track your own funnel and know where deals stall<br>- Ability to learn a technical, regulated domain quickly<br>- Self-directed and organized in a fully remote setting<br>- Native English speaker, available during US Central Time business hours</p> <p>NICE TO HAVE<br>- Experience selling into utilities, energy, construction, field services, or regulated industries<br>- Familiarity with storm restoration, line work, vegetation management, or contractor ecosystems<br>- Exposure to both enterprise (long-cycle) and SMB or self-serve sales motions<br>- Experience selling workforce management, compliance, or fintech products<br>- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience</p> <p>COMPENSATION AND PROBATION<br>- Competitive market base plus uncapped commission. Base is paid bi-weekly and commission quarterly.<br>- Accelerators: 1.5x at 101-125% of quota, 2.0x above 125%.<br>- The first six months are probationary, with performance reviews at 3 and 6 months against ramped KPI targets (demos held, conversions, follow-up coverage). <br>- If targets are not met, Kyro may extend the probationary period or end employment. - - Employment remains at-will during and after probation.</p> <p>WHAT WE OFFER<br>- Competitive base and variable pay<br>- A fully remote role<br>- A clear path to Account Executive for SDRs who consistently hit target<br>- Direct exposure to product and leadership at a company shaping how utilities run storm response</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative</a></p> Tue, 13 Oct 2026 17:13:53 +0000 Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:13:53 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/kyro-ai-sales-development-representative Airbnb: Senior Manager, Quality, Volume Tiers Anywhere in the World 🇨🇦 Canada California Management and Finance Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6567/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb/">https://careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb/</a> </p> <p>Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost ever
